priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield, Flametongue Weapon, and Thunderstrike Ward at all times.
Cast Stormkeeper pre-combat or whenever Ascendance has more than 10 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Cast Ascendance if Stormkeeper is on cooldown for more than 15 seconds.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities during Ascendance or if the fight is about to end.
Apply or refresh Flame Shock (or use Voltaic Blaze) if Master of the Elements is not active and the DoT is refreshable.
Cast Lava Burst if Master of the Elements is down and you have room for Maelstrom, especially with a Lava Surge proc.
Cast Tempest if the Master of the Elements buff is active.
Use Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts, preferably while Master of the Elements is active.
Spend Maelstrom on Elemental Blast as your primary spender.
Spend Maelstrom on Earth Shock if Elemental Blast is not available.
Cast Tempest whenever it is available if not used for Master of the Elements.
Cast Lightning Bolt as your primary filler to generate Maelstrom.
When moving, use Spiritwalker's Grace; otherwise, use Flame Shock, Voltaic Blaze, or Frost Shock.
